description: Stage a change to the signed-in merchant's website, built and hosted on SiteMe. prompt describes the change in plain words (3 to 1000 characters); page optionally names one page by its short name, such as about, and without it the home page changes. Returns intent, expires_at and consequence: the exact request, the page, the website edits left this month (100 a month) and that SiteMe's AI makes the change live straight away, with no preview; it can be undone afterwards with prepare_undo_website_edit. Requires company:write and the Pro plan; confirm_website_edit applies it after approval.
name: prepare_website_edit
title: Prepare a website edit
